'''Winsafra The Death Star still rules''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 1 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Central Core|Premiere-D-deathstarcentralcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: Central Core
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Death Star Central Core Winsafra DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

As long as you play it the right way, the death star still destroys all!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Basic strategy, get the gunners and someone out to protect them out as soon as possible. Use the weapon levs to try and get the death star moving toward whatever system your opponent is on by first turn. If you get him out, try and use the little droid to move faster. Make sure to never ever drop any starships down without a way to get out(TIE'S need a dreadnaught or else their SCREWED NEXT TURN!). Two commence primaries should be plenty to take out their system, or 2 if their spread out. You may wanna play another commence primary, i think 2 is fine though. This is the most fun deck type ever, so if you have any suggestions for me, or you have a different type(remember, no objective, it screws everything up) just lemme know in your response. I'm always looking for help with the death star :)

Yours in Gaming

Carl
